title: Validate and enable actual Vulkan shaderInt64 before accepting Int64 modules
body:
The public Vulkan adapter currently leaves shaderInt64 disabled at vkCreateDevice, while ValidateVulkanKernelPrecision ignores OpCapability Int64. An externally supplied valid Int64 module can therefore reach vkCreateShaderModule without the required logical-device feature. This also blocks a valid evaluation of #44's optional exact64-bit division path.

A pure current6d2 validator probe reports requested_Int64=true,logical_Int64_enabled=false,admitted=true, with0 Vulkan calls. The complete current Endpoint candidate compiles and passes its existing type/interface/float/mode/barrier checks at df1d78db; it declares Int64 and must not be dispatched through the old factory. No numerical or benefit conclusion is established.

Required repair: query actual shaderInt64 support, report it honestly, enable it only where advertised, and reject Int64 modules before driver work on unsupported/unenabled devices. Preserve existing Float64/FMA, portability and malformed-module admission. No feature/property masking or unsupported fallback. Keep retained arithmetic and all35 shipped shaders unchanged during this admission repair.

Acceptance: strengthen the existing pure precision-admission controls, verify required feature preservation through ordinary portability/FMA creation, build strict GCC/Clang consumers, and bind actual public Vulkan query/create/module/dispatch arguments on a supported provider with independent64-bit output expectations. No unsupported module dispatch. Preserve matching existing scalar/FP64 controls and distinguish this finite source/runtime capability repair from optional64 division correctness, original8/22 benefit, frame, full science/provider and exact-main installed-release qualification.

Locations: src/sirius/backend/device.h; src/sirius/backend/vulkan/vulkan_device.cpp and .h; tests/backend/vulkan_smoke_test.cpp. Normative shaderInt64 requirement: https://docs.vulkan.org/refpages/latest/refpages/source/VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures.html .
